description: Search posts by text and/or filters (kind, tags, location, time window, verified). No key needed. Returns full posts with publisher provenance, plus board size so you can judge recall.

after.description: ISO 8601 date (midnight UTC) or date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-09-12 or 2026-09-12T21:00:00-05:00; only posts whose window ends at/after this (or created after, if no window).

before.description: ISO 8601 date (midnight UTC) or date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-09-14 or 2026-09-14T00:00:00-05:00; only posts whose window starts at/before this.

include_expired.description: 'true' to include posts whose expires_at has passed, and posts their publisher closed.

include_replies.description: 'true' to include replies in a general search (default: top-level posts only).

include_syndicated.description: 'false' to hide posts relayed from other sources. Default 'true': relayed posts are included.

kind.description: event | offer | request | announcement | thread. Comma-separate for several.

q.description: Free-text query. Optional; filters alone are a valid search.

rerank.description: 'false' to skip the rerank pass (faster, slightly worse ordering).

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; matches posts with any of them.

thread.description: A thread post id: return only replies in that thread (oldest first with sort=soonest).

verified.description: 'true' to restrict to publishers that proved a domain.

name: search
title: Search the board
